title: System Testing Specifications & Verification Rules

functional_testing: Module 01: User login via Google/Facebook auth, role resolution, permission enforcement.
Module 02: Package listing, package details display, menu item association.
Module 03: Customer reservation form submission, guest count validation, mandatory field checking.
Module 04: Date availability checks, single-day & multi-day scheduling, schedule conflict prevention.
Module 05: Package customization price calculations, menu selection validation, requirement generation.
Module 06: Stock additions, reservation on order confirmation, stock deduction, low stock & insufficient stock alerts.
Module 07: Deposit & installment recording, total_paid derivation, remaining_balance derivation, payment_status derivation.
Module 08: Equipment release recording, physical check verification, classification of returned/missing/damaged quantities.
Module 09: Generation of reservation, sales, payment, inventory, and equipment reports; CSV/Excel export; print view rendering.
Module 10: Audit logging for protected actions, immutable log verification.
database_schema_testing: Required Fields & Types: Verify missing required fields produce validation errors.
Foreign Key Integrity: Verify non-existent foreign keys fail cleanly.
Enum Enforcement: Verify invalid enum strings are rejected.
Derived Value Calculations: Verify available_quantity, total_paid, remaining_balance, payment_status match formulas.
Snapshot Preservation: Verify altering master package price does NOT modify confirmed orders.
Append-Only Verification: Verify Inventory Movement, Payment Transaction, Audit Trail cannot be overwritten or deleted.
security_testing: Unauthorized Access: Verify unauthenticated users cannot access staff/admin interfaces.
Role Restrictions: Verify customer role cannot confirm reservations, modify schedules, update stock, record payments, or verify equipment.
Customer Ownership: Verify customer cannot read/modify another customer's records.
Confirmed Lock: Verify customer cannot edit reservations or package details once confirmed.
Financial Safeguards: Verify payments exceeding remaining balance are rejected.
Schedule Conflicts: Verify overlapping schedule creation is rejected.
performance_usability: Test responsiveness under GitHub Pages static hosting and Firebase connection conditions.
Verify desktop browser and installable PWA mobile usability for all three roles.
Report accuracy depends on correct, complete, and timely manual data entry by authorized staff.

testing_framework_boundary: Do NOT introduce custom automated testing frameworks (Jest, Cypress, Selenium) unless specified in a Phase 2 decision. Use plain JS assertions and browser console integration tests.
